description: Lite transformer temperature monitor: up to six sensors, four relays, a digital output and a current loop output, cooling groups and winding ageing
source: Treetech LAP Mapa de Protocolos de Comunicação MAP-085, rev. 1.01

sources.title: LAP - Monitor Lite de Temperaturas: Mapa de Protocolos de Comunicação (MAP-085)

notes: Modbus RTU on RS-485, FC01 to FC06, FC15 and FC16. Addresses are 0-based, as sent on the wire.

Baud rate is selectable (4800 to 115200 bit/s), 8 data bits, no parity, 1 or 2 stop bits (detected automatically). The document gives no factory default for the baud rate or the address; 9600 and 1 are assumed here.

The document lists every value as a 16-bit word without stating a scale. Temperatures are whole degrees; the remaining life time (0 to 6553.5 years) and the pulse times (0.1 to 999.9 s) are read as tenths from their ranges.

Left out: the password registers, the first and second alarm and self-diagnostics words (input 0 to 7, the same bits are in the discrete inputs), the 48-bit timestamp, the holding copies of the temperatures (1000 to 1005) and the reset-to-defaults and log reset commands.
The document was written for firmware 1.00 r8. Written from that document; this map has not been tested on a device.
